RadioGroup.description: A `<div role="radiogroup">` that holds which radio is checked and gives its radios a shared name. Inside a FieldRoot it is the field's control.

props.value: The value of the checked radio. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the group. It may be read from an answer that is loading or guessed over (`value={setting}`); one that fails is left to the app's `errored` region.
props.defaultValue: The value checked at first, when the group isn't controlled. Without one, no radio is checked. The radio holding it carries the `checked` attribute, so a form reset checks it again.
props.onValueChange: Called with the radio's value when the user checks another radio, and once when a form reset returns an uncontrolled group to its default (not when the reset clears a group that has none). It is called in a change of its own, so it may be an action that saves: the radios are never held by it. A controlled group keeps its radio checked until the owner writes the new value, or guesses it.
props.disabled: Disables every radio in the group natively. A radio disabled while it has focus (`disabled={pending? setting}`) takes focus back when it is enabled again, if focus hasn't moved elsewhere.
props.readOnly: The radios stay focusable and the arrow keys move between them, but none can be checked. Sets `aria-readonly` and `data-readonly`. `readOnly={pending? setting}` locks the group while a save is out without losing focus.
props.required: Sets the native `required` attribute on each radio: one must be checked for the form, or the Field, to be valid. Also sets `aria-required` on the group.
props.name: The radios' shared name: they submit the checked value under it. Without one, the FieldRoot's name is used, else a generated one.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the group is disabled, by its own prop or by its Field or Fieldset.
dataAttributes.data-readonly: Present when the group is read-only.
dataAttributes.data-invalid: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field is invalid.
dataAttributes.data-valid: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field has been validated and is valid.
dataAttributes.data-touched: Inside a FieldRoot: present once focus has been in the group and left it.
dataAttributes.data-dirty: Inside a FieldRoot: present while the value differs from its initial one.
dataAttributes.data-filled: Inside a FieldRoot: present while a radio is checked.
dataAttributes.data-focused: Inside a FieldRoot: present while focus is on one of the radios.

RadioRoot.description: A radio: a native `<input type="radio">` that carries the group's name. Its children are rendered after it, as its siblings. Style it with `appearance: none`, `:checked`, `:disabled`, `:focus-visible` and `:user-invalid`.

props.value: The value the group holds, and the form submits, while this radio is checked.
props.disabled: Disables this radio natively: the arrow keys skip it.
props.readOnly: Keeps this radio focusable but cancels a press, so it can't be checked.

dataAttributes.data-readonly: Present when the radio or its group is read-only.

RadioIndicator.description: A mark shown beside the radio, always in the document. Place it in RadioRoot, where it is the radio's next sibling, and show it with `.Radio:checked + .Indicator`. It is `aria-hidden`.
